items.title: Italian man throws away €1 million winning lottery ticket — sanitation workers find it two days later
items.dek: A man in Bitonto, Italy, won €1 million but mistakenly threw away the winning ticket after seeing the message "not payable" and assuming it was not a winner. Th
items.body: A man in Bitonto, Italy, won €1 million but mistakenly threw away the winning ticket after seeing the message "not payable" and assuming it was not a winner. The ticket ended up in the trash, but sanitation workers managed to recover it two days later, allowing him to claim the prize. submitted by /u/Ok-Opinion-7160 [link] [comments]
